description: This file implements a trace viewer server and related utilities for handling trace files, serving trace data, and launching a trace viewer application in a browser environment. It includes server setup, trace validation, and UI launching functions.

classes.name: StdinServer
classes.description: Implements a transport interface that reads trace URLs from stdin and manages trace loading requests.

methods.name: validateTraceUrlOrPath
methods.description: Validates and converts a trace file path or URL, synthesizing a file URL if necessary.

methods.name: startTraceViewerServer
methods.description: Creates and starts an HTTP server for serving trace viewer UI and trace data.

methods.name: installRootRedirect
methods.description: Sets up a redirect route to the trace viewer web app with appropriate query parameters.

methods.name: runTraceViewerApp
methods.description: Starts the trace viewer server, installs redirect, and opens the trace viewer app in a browser.

methods.name: runTraceInBrowser
methods.description: Starts the trace viewer server and opens the trace in a browser.

methods.name: openTraceViewerApp
methods.description: Launches the trace viewer application in a browser context.

methods.name: openTraceInBrowser
methods.description: Opens a trace URL in the default browser.

methods.name: toFilePathUrl
methods.description: Converts a file path to a file URL with encoded path.
